subject.title: feat: clarify publisher discovery state labels

question: Should this PR establish the publisher profile/discovery trust-label vocabulary now, or should it wait for consolidation with the adjacent account-feed stack?
rationale: The implementation is narrow, but the new spec intentionally creates durable terminology for profile, feed, search, official, review, scan, follow, and local approval states; that is product/spec direction rather than a purely mechanical code fix.

options.title: Accept With Proof
options.body: Require real browser proof, then land this narrow `Official`/profile-state vocabulary slice as the current direction.

options.title: Consolidate With Feed Stack
options.body: Keep this draft open until https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2948 and related feed/profile drafts settle the vocabulary together.

options.title: Narrow To UI Copy Only
options.body: Ask the contributor to drop or defer the durable spec and keep only the visible copy/tests for this PR.

recommendation.title: Accept With Proof
recommendation.body: Require real browser proof, then land this narrow `Official`/profile-state vocabulary slice as the current direction.
